definitions.explanation: Describes someone who gets angry or frustrated easily and quickly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気|き}が{短|みじか}い。
{気|き}が{短|みじか}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧がしにくい。
examples.english: It's hard to work with impatient people.
I feel like I've become more impatient as I've gotten older.

examples.japanese: {気|き}が{短|みじか}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{分|わ}かっている→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{直|なお}せない→直す：00869_naosu⟧。
examples.english: I know I'm short-tempered, but I just can't fix it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気|き}が{短|みじか}くて、{待|ま}たされる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{怒|おこ}り{出|だ}す→怒り出す：29598_okoridasu⟧。⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦{慣|な}れている→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather is short-tempered and gets angry as soon as he's kept waiting. The whole family is used to it.

notes:
STRUCTURE: ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧ (temperament) + ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ + ⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧ (short). Literally 'one's temperament is short.'

ANTONYM: ⟦{気|き}が{長|なが}い→気が長い：30580_kiganagai⟧ (patient, even-tempered), built on ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦せっかち→せっかち：06646_sekkachi⟧ (impatient, hasty) - similar but focuses more on rushing
- ⟦{短気|たんき}→短気：10913_tanki⟧ (short temper) - noun form
- ⟦{短気|たんき}→短気：10913_tanki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧ (to lose one's temper)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {気|き}が{短|みじか}い: describes a standing personality trait
- ⟦{怒|おこ}りっぽい→怒りっぽい：30581_okorippoi⟧: prone to anger (similar but more colloquial)
